concepts.title: BG01 튜토리얼 · 오솔길 초입
concepts.prompt:
Create ONE widescreen environment concept image for Scroll Hunter, a fixed-camera real-time fantasy battle game. Empty environment only: absolutely no characters, monsters, UI, text, labels, borders, panels or logos. Visual family: grounded stylized low-poly-friendly fantasy, broad sculpted silhouettes, restrained hand-painted surface detail, matte materials, gentle cartoon shading, moderately detailed rather than simplistic mobile cartoon or photorealism. Landscape 16:9. Camera at a human eye-level slightly elevated, looking horizontally into the environment, mild downward tilt and natural perspective, not isometric or bird's-eye. The bottom 25 percent must remain low-detail level ground for the UI; the center and middle foreground form a wide unobstructed battle clearing for up to three standing human enemies in a row. Keep high contrast branches, rocks and scenery out of their silhouettes; layer scenery at sides and rear. Soft neutral fill lighting must illuminate the arena and future characters from the camera side, no crushed blacks, no heavy vignette, no strong colored wash or harsh cast shadows. No floating platform, diorama base, cutaway miniature or isolated terrain island. A believable continuous world filling the view.
Scene: the welcoming edge of a temperate medieval forest before entering a woodland trail. A broad sunlit packed-earth approach, a few scattered low rounded mossy rocks and muted green grass tufts along both sides, widely spaced mature deciduous trees opening toward a pale blue-green forest trail in the distance. Clear daylight, muted olive and sage foliage, warm earth, soft blue sky, substantial open sky and light between tree crowns. Rural uninhabited woodland, no buildings or props unrelated to a forest. Distinctly more open and inviting than a dense forest interior.
